_to argument of checkBots is forwarded to the external bot check call.
_value argument of checkBots is forwarded to the external bot check call.
The external call to botProtection executes before any state change and its boolean result gates execution of the guarded body via require(notABot).
checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom and performs the untrusted external call before the balance and allowance updates.

normalization_plan.reason: The _botProtection parameter only exists to initialize the botProtection state variable inside the constructor.
_from is a bound argument of the checkBots modifier and has no independent semantic role.
_to is a bound argument of the checkBots modifier and has no independent semantic role.
_value is a bound argument of the checkBots modifier and has no independent semantic role.
_from is only used to index balanceOf and allowance inside transferFrom.
_to is only used to index balanceOf inside transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked balance and allowance updates inside transferFrom.
_spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
_value is only written into the allowance mapping inside approve.
The a parameter is the direct target address of the delegatecall operation.
The b parameter is the direct calldata of the delegatecall operation.
_numList only sets balances and the liquidity token amount within list.
_tos is only iterated over to assign recipient balances inside list.
_amounts is only read to set recipient balances inside list.
The loop counter i is a temporary index local to the distribution loop in list.
